notes:
v4.6.143 — Position gauge: show every position + realistic per-stock targets

🎯 The position gauge now ALWAYS shows every open position. Positions whose broker doesn't report an entry price (some IBKR sub-portfolios) were being dropped from the DAY bot's gauge — they now render at break-even instead of vanishing.

📐 For bots without their own take-profit/stop-loss, the gauge's target/stop zones are no longer a flat one-size-fits-all band: every position now gets a realistic target sized by that stock's own ATR (volatility), so a calm stock and a volatile one show different objectives.

Update via the in-app banner.
